placements.title: System architecture and operational contracts
placements.frame: What architectural decisions and contracts govern how the system operates?

placements.title: Async remember as immediate-receipt dispatch with poll-or-piggyback retrieval
placements.frame: What immediate-return and retrieval guarantees does the async remember contract establish, and how does its dispatch-and-poll design prevent lost work?
placements.why: All three segments describe a single ratified contract: remember returns a receipt immediately, extraction is watched by polling a cursor, no blocking call occurs, no work is lost if the receipt is dropped, and retrieval happens either by polling or by piggybacking on a later call. This is a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding — the async remember contract's operational design — not a one-time fact or measurement. It passes the grain test: the contract's shape is true beyond the words that describe it here.
